chapters.title: The First Vision and the Restoration
chapters.synopsis: Confused by a religious revival near Palmyra, fourteen-year-old Joseph Smith reads James 1:5 and prays in a grove, where the Father and the Son appear and tell him to join none of the churches. Three years later the angel Moroni tells him of a record on gold plates, which he obtains in 1827 and translates with Oliver Cowdery as scribe. In May 1829 John the Baptist confers the Aaronic Priesthood, and Joseph and Oliver baptize each other.
